{{2013–14 Big Ten men's basketball standings}}
The '''2013–14 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team''' represented [[Ohio State University]]<!--Wikipedians do not use "The" as part of Ohio State's name; it is considered a marketing gimmick, and routinely deleted.--> in the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]].  Their head coach was [[Thad Matta]], in his tenth season with the Buckeyes.  The team played its home games at [[Value City Arena]] in [[Columbus, Ohio]] and was a member of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 25–10, 10–8 in Big Ten play to finish in fifth place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2014 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] where they lost to rival Michigan. They received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Dayton.

==Before the season==

===Previous season===
The Buckeye finished the season with 29–8 overall, 13–5 in Big Ten play and won the [[2013 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to earn a trip to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]]. They were in the 2nd seed in the west and defeated [[2012–13 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]] in the second round, [[2012–13 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] in the third round, and [[2013–14 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] in the sweet sixteen before falling in the elite eight against [[2012–13 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]].
